name: United Commune of People
startIntroPart1:
The Underground Great Wall project started back 80 years ago. It keeps growing relentlessly, Until the end of the world. 
Working men of all Countries, unite! The revolution will continue, even though the human history has reached its lowest point. Capitalism, reactionary forces remains. Fight back all at once!
declaringWar: Again, don't say it wasn't forewarned
attacked: All reactionary force are mere fake tigers made out of paper, and you will strand in ocean of the people's war.
defeated: The revolution wont die, as long as there are exploitation, there will be revolution.
denounced: Speak for yourself, all your slanders are vaild against your regime as well.
neutralDenouncing: Don't say you haven't been forewarned.
hateDenouncing: Your ideology is a death cult. And we are ready to recieve refugees from your camp.
introduction: I'm Li de sheng, I stand for proletarians of the world, if you are not reactionary scum, we could have some allies.
hateHello: You are to be hanged on a lamp post, if you even have any.
tradeRequest: Trading materials is good for rebuilding this mess, isn't it?
declaringFriendship: Our people and your people are in a war against the fallout already. It is time that we estabilish a proper alliance.
neutralRejectingDemand: You ask for too much yet you give so little.
hateRejectingDemand: Your greed is akin to that of a billionaire, yet you are in extreme porverty in terms of dignity.
